name: scs-netlify-functions
description: Server-only Netlify Functions dependencies. Never bundle credentials into the browser.

comments.locking: Exact version pin for the PostgreSQL driver. A package-lock.json with integrity hashes must be generated by an authorized npm install inside this directory (npm install --package-lock-only). Do not invent lockfile integrity values. Netlify installs from this package.json during Functions build; commit the lockfile once Owner authorizes network install.
